units.rawText: After looking for all these years, I've found you at last, Vayne...

units.rawText: Chris has fallen asleep. Tony scoops him up and lays him on the bed in the other room.
units.displayText: Chris has fallen asleep. Tony scoops him up and lays him on the bed in the other room.

units.rawText: Said room is little more than a space partitioned off by a curtain and a shabby door that is barely big enough to hold a folding bed.

units.rawText: It might be too small for an adult, but it's just right for the 10-year-old Chris.
units.displayText: It might be too small for an adult, but it's just right for the 10-year-old Chris.

units.rawText: Why... did he have a look like that on his face...
units.displayText: Why... did he have a look like that on his face...

spans.text: Why... did he have a look like that on his face...

units.rawText: Tony recalls the smile on Centaureissi's face just now and lapses into thought. He saw an expression very much like that not long ago...
units.displayText: Tony recalls the smile on Centaureissi's face just now and lapses into thought. He saw an expression very much like that not long ago...

spans.text: Tony recalls the smile on Centaureissi's face just now and lapses into thought. He saw an expression very much like that not long ago...

units.rawText: Sir, let me bind your wounds. Be patient and wait for Chris. I'm sure he'll bring a doctor back!
units.displayText: Sir, let me bind your wounds. Be patient and wait for Chris. I'm sure he'll bring a doctor back!

spans.text: Sir, let me bind your wounds. Be patient and wait for Chris. I'm sure he'll bring a doctor back!

units.rawText: ...Sorry for bluffing you, Tony. I didn't actually send Chris off to find a doctor. Instead, I had him go pick up the Commander I was supposed to meet.
units.displayText: ...Sorry for bluffing you, Tony. I didn't actually send Chris off to find a doctor. Instead, I had him go pick up the Commander I was supposed to meet.

spans.text: ...Sorry for bluffing you, Tony. I didn't actually send Chris off to find a doctor. Instead, I had him go pick up the Commander I was supposed to meet.

units.rawText: What, what kind of bad joke is that, sir? At this rate your wounds...!
units.displayText: What, what kind of bad joke is that, sir? At this rate your wounds...!

spans.text: What, what kind of bad joke is that, sir? At this rate your wounds...!

units.rawText: Izka doesn't say a thing. He simply moves his hand to tiredly peel open his uniform tunic, revealing the gore-stained vest below.
units.displayText: Izka doesn't say a thing. He simply moves his hand to tiredly peel open his uniform tunic, revealing the gore-stained vest below.

spans.text: Izka doesn't say a thing. He simply moves his hand to tiredly peel open his uniform tunic, revealing the gore-stained vest below.

units.rawText: Hng!
units.displayText: Hng!

spans.text: Hng!

units.rawText: Even though Tony doesn't have any medical knowledge, he knows the wounds under the Lieutenant's uniform are not the kind that can be treated.
units.displayText: Even though Tony doesn't have any medical knowledge, he knows the wounds under the Lieutenant's uniform are not the kind that can be treated.

spans.text: Even though Tony doesn't have any medical knowledge, he knows the wounds under the Lieutenant's uniform are not the kind that can be treated.

units.rawText: There aren't any more medical Dolls in the city... And all the friends who helped us before have all been shot or blown to bits.
units.displayText: There aren't any more medical Dolls in the city... And all the friends who helped us before have all been shot or blown to bits.

spans.text: There aren't any more medical Dolls in the city... And all the friends who helped us before have all been shot or blown to bits.

units.rawText: ...Therefore, rather than waste more time on a dying dog like me I'd rather find the Commander ASAP and make sure no more innocent lives get drawn into the conflict.
units.displayText: ...Therefore, rather than waste more time on a dying dog like me I'd rather find the Commander ASAP and make sure no more innocent lives get drawn into the conflict.

spans.text: ...Therefore, rather than waste more time on a dying dog like me I'd rather find the Commander ASAP and make sure no more innocent lives get drawn into the conflict.

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka tries to get up and look out the window, but his legs wobble and in the end he slumps weakly against the wall.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka tries to get up and look out the window, but his legs wobble and in the end he slumps weakly against the wall.

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka tries to get up and look out the window, but his legs wobble and in the end he slumps weakly against the wall.

units.rawText: As he looks at himself reflected in the glass, he laughs bitterly. The fighting and its toll have made a mockery of his severity.
units.displayText: As he looks at himself reflected in the glass, he laughs bitterly. The fighting and its toll have made a mockery of his severity.

spans.text: As he looks at himself reflected in the glass, he laughs bitterly. The fighting and its toll have made a mockery of his severity.

units.rawText: Speaking of which... I haven't had you give me a shave for a while now.
units.displayText: Speaking of which... I haven't had you give me a shave for a while now.

spans.text: Speaking of which... I haven't had you give me a shave for a while now.

units.rawText: Are you still on the clock, Tony?
units.displayText: Are you still on the clock, Tony?

spans.text: Are you still on the clock, Tony?

units.rawText: ...Only VIPs get 24/7 service. But for you, I can make an exception.
units.displayText: ...Only VIPs get 24/7 service. But for you, I can make an exception.

spans.text: ...Only VIPs get 24/7 service. But for you, I can make an exception.

units.rawText: Heh... lucky me, then.
units.displayText: Heh... lucky me, then.

spans.text: Heh... lucky me, then.

units.rawText: Tony opens up his bags and takes out the implements of his trade which he spent several hours packing, then heads over to the wall where the lieutenant is and begins to work with practiced skill.
units.displayText: Tony opens up his bags and takes out the implements of his trade which he spent several hours packing, then heads over to the wall where the lieutenant is and begins to work with practiced skill.

spans.text: Tony opens up his bags and takes out the implements of his trade which he spent several hours packing, then heads over to the wall where the lieutenant is and begins to work with practiced skill.

units.rawText: Supplies of shaving foam were cut off during the early stages of the fighting... I hope you can understand.
units.displayText: Supplies of shaving foam were cut off during the early stages of the fighting... I hope you can understand.

spans.text: Supplies of shaving foam were cut off during the early stages of the fighting... I hope you can understand.

units.rawText: As he begins carefully working on the lieutenant's face, Tony suddenly realizes that he hasn't looked closely at Izka for a long time.
units.displayText: As he begins carefully working on the lieutenant's face, Tony suddenly realizes that he hasn't looked closely at Izka for a long time.

spans.text: As he begins carefully working on the lieutenant's face, Tony suddenly realizes that he hasn't looked closely at Izka for a long time.

units.rawText: The kid who was whining about being a soldier and asking for a shave is long gone, replaced by a stalwart soldier who's been through all kinds of fighting to defend his nation.
units.displayText: The kid who was whining about being a soldier and asking for a shave is long gone, replaced by a stalwart soldier who's been through all kinds of fighting to defend his nation.

spans.text: The kid who was whining about being a soldier and asking for a shave is long gone, replaced by a stalwart soldier who's been through all kinds of fighting to defend his nation.

units.rawText: As the thought crosses his mind, the hand holding his razor trembles, and he accidentally nicks Izka's face.
units.displayText: As the thought crosses his mind, the hand holding his razor trembles, and he accidentally nicks Izka's face.

spans.text: As the thought crosses his mind, the hand holding his razor trembles, and he accidentally nicks Izka's face.

units.rawText: My apologies, sir! I hope I didn't hurt you!
units.displayText: My apologies, sir! I hope I didn't hurt you!

spans.text: My apologies, sir! I hope I didn't hurt you!

units.rawText: Don't worry about it. Actually, this is the first time I've seen you mess up like that... Got something on your mind?
units.displayText: Don't worry about it. Actually, this is the first time I've seen you mess up like that... Got something on your mind?

spans.text: Don't worry about it. Actually, this is the first time I've seen you mess up like that... Got something on your mind?

units.rawText: After seeing Tony clam up, Lieutenant Izka quickly changes the subject.
units.displayText: After seeing Tony clam up, Lieutenant Izka quickly changes the subject.

spans.text: After seeing Tony clam up, Lieutenant Izka quickly changes the subject.

units.rawText: Oh yeah, Chris is a big fan of your skills... Once the fighting is over, could you give him a haircut?
units.displayText: Oh yeah, Chris is a big fan of your skills... Once the fighting is over, could you give him a haircut?

spans.text: Oh yeah, Chris is a big fan of your skills... Once the fighting is over, could you give him a haircut?

units.rawText: ...Yeah, leave it to me.
units.displayText: ...Yeah, leave it to me.

spans.text: ...Yeah, leave it to me.

units.rawText: I'll be counting on you... Maestro Tony.
units.displayText: I'll be counting on you... Maestro Tony.

spans.text: I'll be counting on you... Maestro Tony.

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka's determined grin overlaps with Chris' innocent sleeping face, until they blend into the reality before his eyes.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka's determined grin overlaps with Chris' innocent sleeping face, until they blend into the reality before his eyes.

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka's determined grin overlaps with Chris' innocent sleeping face, until they blend into the reality before his eyes.

units.rawText: Chris... I haven't had the chance to keep my promise to your father...
units.displayText: Chris... I haven't had the chance to keep my promise to your father...

spans.text: Chris... I haven't had the chance to keep my promise to your father...

units.rawText: But how do you see him now...
units.displayText: But how do you see him now...

spans.text: But how do you see him now...

units.rawText: Zzzzzz...
units.displayText: Zzzzzz...

spans.text: Zzzzzz...

units.rawText: Forget it, I won't disturb your rest anymore.
units.displayText: Forget it, I won't disturb your rest anymore.

spans.text: Forget it, I won't disturb your rest anymore.

units.rawText: Sweet dreams, kid.
units.displayText: Sweet dreams, kid.

units.displayText: Tony gently pulls the blanket over Chris, then prepares himself to discuss Chris' safety with the Commander.

spans.text: Tony gently pulls the blanket over Chris, then prepares himself to discuss Chris' safety with the Commander.

units.rawText: In the darkness, Chris opens his eyes and looks outside, at the roaring blizzard.
units.displayText: In the darkness, Chris opens his eyes and looks outside, at the roaring blizzard.

spans.text: In the darkness, Chris opens his eyes and looks outside, at the roaring blizzard.

units.rawText: Dad... is a hero... He's a hero who gave his life to protect me...
units.displayText: Dad... is a hero... He's a hero who gave his life to protect me...

spans.text: Dad... is a hero... He's a hero who gave his life to protect me...

units.rawText: Dad... Are you feeling cold now?
units.displayText: Dad... Are you feeling cold now?

spans.text: Dad... Are you feeling cold now?

units.displayText: Chris thinks of how his father ruffled his hair one last time before saying farewell, and the tears slowly roll down his cheek again.

spans.text: Chris thinks of how his father ruffled his hair one last time before saying farewell, and the tears slowly roll down his cheek again.

units.displayText: When nobody is looking, Chris quietly opens a window and sneaks out of the safehouse in the night.

spans.text: When nobody is looking, Chris quietly opens a window and sneaks out of the safehouse in the night.
